text:
incident-bot: ALERT: metering_alert triggered — token_count_delta spike detected (us-west-2 aggregator). rule: delta > 20% over 15m. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/ops/metering-high-delta. paging @samir :rotating_light:

samir: on it, pulling recent metrics and consumer status. any queued customer-facing alerts?

billing-ops: seeing recon task failures: `kafka_consumer_lag` ~120k on consumer group `usage-consumer`, emitter ack timeouts in logs. looks like ingestion backlog after gateway spike.

samir: confirmed from logs: `consumer_partition_lag{partition="7"} = 123456` — going to restart the consumer pod and watch. :eyes: 

elaine: we have replays queued in reconciler. restarting consumer will start processing queued messages — risk of duplicate counts unless we enable dedupe. prepping a patch to set dedupe-mode=soft.

samir: restarted pod usage-consumer-12 -> new pod ready. watching token delta and kafka lag. patch? paste the command you plan to run.

elaine: running dry-run: `reconciler --prefix=2024-11-01 --mode=dry-run --dedupe=soft --sample=part7` — sample shows duplicate candidate count ~0. Will promote to commit if no issues.

incident-bot: update: token_count_gap reduced from +48% to +7% within 8m after consumer restart. kafka_consumer_lag trending down.

billing-ops: customer-impact: 3 customers flagged provisional overages (acct 1487, 2312, 9981). billing UI shows 'estimate' badge for those windows. marketing emails suppressed. CS notified. @carla please confirm outreach.

carla: confirmed — sent notice to affected accounts, opened tickets with severity P3, and offered to reconcile any incorrectly applied charges. customers asked for ETA on credits; we committed to a 24h reconciliation window.

elaine: promoting reconciler commit now: `reconciler --prefix=2024-11-01 --mode=commit --dedupe=soft --concurrency=3` — kicking off. watching job logs: "reconcile: processed 54k msgs, duplicates 12 (soft)".

samir: good. dry-run -> commit looks clean. current checks: `token_delta < 5%`, `kafka_lag < 5k`. If metrics hold, we'll mark incident resolved. creating fallback plan in case counts dip: fallback to shadow-ledger totals (runbook: billing-fallback-2023).

billing-ops: noted. if reconciler ever causes undercount we have rollback: 1) pause reconciler commit 2) restore from shadow-ledger snapshot 3) open immediate rollback ticket.

samir: handing off to @nina for overnight monitoring at 02:00 PT (handoff ts: 1735810000). Nina — checklist: verify kafka lag <5k, token_delta <5%, update CS on any changes, and escalate if any customer sees persistent overage flags.

nina: acked. taking over overnight. I'll keep an eye on the reconciler job and open an internal postmortem once we stabilize. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: RESOLVED: token_count drift returned to baseline. incident duration ~43m. summary: transient gateway spike caused consumer backpressure -> backlog -> temporary overage flags. actions: consumer restart, reconciler dedupe commit, CS outreach. RCA assigned to metering-eng (elaine) for follow-up.
